scope: Versioned behavioral scoring; no model implementation or weights.
interval_value: right endpoint, clipped to the exact final 0.48-second window
distance: Euclidean XYZ distance between logged base positions
heading: angle between horizontal body forward and robot-to-original vector
original_success_if_saved: preserve in a separate field; never fill missing original success with a geometry result
threshold_provenance: Existing independent Same geometric qualification; recomputed without invoking the previous qualification function
